messages.subject: I'm back!! with Deducer 0.7-7
parts:
Hi all,

I've had a bit of a hiatus from the list due to external concerns, but I'm back now. I've just released Deducer 0.7-7 to CRAN. The release contains a number of bug fixes, changes to satisfy CRAN and one new feature. The new feature added is the ability to predict outcomes using linear/logistic/glm models on new datasets. The option is available in the model explorer -> export dialog.

Some notes regarding the list traffic while I was away:

@lurie: Thanks for the typo notice. feel free to edit the wiki with the password 571113

@lurie, @suhada: The error with datasets masked by functions (such as sample) is fixed in the new CRAN version.

@malcolm: indeed, that is a bug in JGR. I've added a fix for this edge case (thats a lot of packages!), but it may take some time before another JGR release to CRAN.

@Youngnam: Deducer is meant to be used within JGR not RStudio. launch JGR with JGR()

Note that stats-ros...@listserv.uni-augsburg.de (not here) is the best list for problems related to launching/installing JGR.

Ian
